title: Near you
intro: The nearest stickers while the app is open.
why: Only while the app is open. We do not store where you are.
denied: Location permission was not given. You can turn it on in the browser settings.
failed: We could not tell where you are. Try again.
nearBody: {place} is {dist} away. Is it still there?
nearBy: {type} by {name}, {dist} away. Is it still there?
compassNote: Without the compass, arrows point relative to north.
